confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, pdfplumber/pdftotext fallback, targeted methods review, and official publisher HTML were checked. Core Segment 1-4 task parameters are mostly reported; exact speaker model, exact pink-noise asset, T0/T6 offsets, and response timeout remain unresolved.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The PPS task can be recreated as an analog two-speaker or digital two-source pink-noise approach profile with the reported path, duration, gain law, SOAs, target/catch counts, and pre/post FAM session structure. Exact room/speaker transfer function and original noise sample are not reported.

source_checks.scope: Used as primary extracted-text map, then checked against PDF/fallback extraction.
Targeted apparatus, stimulus, task, timing, response, count, and analysis searches.
Official article page checked for supplementary materials and data availability; no supplementary-material section was found, and raw data are by request.

review_attempts.result: Mapped candidate Segment 1-4 values across 22 of 25 fields.
pdfplumber and pdftotext confirmed the apparatus, timing, SOA, count, and response details despite duplicate PDF text layers.
Identified pink noise, physical two-speaker far-to-near apparent trajectory, duration, cross-fade envelope, and apparatus.

review_attempts.strategy: Sequence, baseline, catch, and repetition pass
review_attempts.result: Separated target trials, auditory-only catch trials, T0/T6 baseline-like trials, analyzed T1-T5 delays, and pre/post session structure.
Official MDPI HTML did not expose a supplementary-material section; remaining raw data are available only by request.

stimulus_type.evidence_note: Reported as samples of pink noise used for the auditory stimuli.

source_provenance.value: Pink-noise samples delivered by E-Prime 2.0 through physical loudspeakers; exact audio file/generation seed not reported.
source_provenance.evidence_note: Task software and stimulus class are reported; exact source asset is not.

trajectory_count.value: One auditory trajectory: IN/approaching sound from far loudspeaker to near loudspeaker.
trajectory_count.evidence_note: No receding or alternate auditory trajectory is described for this task.

trajectory_path.value: Far-to-near apparent path: near speaker 5 cm from left cheek; far speaker 100 cm from near speaker; same elevation, 100 cm.
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Path is physical-speaker/intensity-based rather than HRTF-rendered.

stimulus_duration.value: Sound duration 3000 ms, preceded and followed by 1000 ms silence.
stimulus_duration.evidence_note: This defines the trial audio timing envelope.

stimulus_speed.value: No explicit speed reported; nominal apparent path is 100 cm over 3000 ms, about 0.33 m/s, under an exponential intensity cross-fade.
stimulus_speed.evidence_note: Derived only from speaker separation and sound duration; perceived motion is intensity-based.

auditory_conditions.value: Approaching IN sound only, presented before and after the FAM intervention.
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: Pre/post is a session factor, not a different auditory stimulus family.

gain_envelope.value: Exponential intensity manipulation from 55 to 70 dB SPL; far speaker decreases while near speaker rises.
gain_envelope.evidence_note: Exact sample-by-sample gain curve is not provided.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Two physical loudspeakers in a soundproof room; near and far sources controlled by E-Prime 2.0.
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: Speaker model and acoustic calibration beyond SPL are not reported.

trial_rows_families.value: Audio-tactile target trials plus auditory-only catch trials; practice/calibration used 10 trials including 2 catches.
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: Target trials cross tactile timing with the IN sound.

condition_intermixing.value: T0-T6 target timings and 20 auditory-only catch trials were randomly intermingled within each 62-trial task session.
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: Pre-FAM and post-FAM sessions were separated by the intervention, not intermingled.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Fixed session order: audio-tactile task, 15 min FAM, audio-tactile task; trial order within task sessions randomized/intermingled.
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: No counterbalanced intervention order is described.

iti_jitter_policy.value: Fixed 1000 ms silence before and after the 3000 ms sound; no variable ITI or jitter range reported.
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: The only explicitly reported inter-trial/timing padding is fixed silence.

response_window.page_or_section: PDF pp.5-6, sections 2.4.1 and 2.5; publisher HTML checked 2026-06-16
response_window.evidence_note: Spacebar response and RT adjustment are reported, but no explicit timeout or response window was found.

task_sequence_rules.value: Participants responded to cheek tactile targets, ignored sound-only catches, and repeated calibration if performance was incorrect.
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: Calibration intensity was adjusted by 5 mA steps after incorrect performance.

tactile_stimulus.value: Left-cheek electrical tactile pulse via DS7A Digitimer and neurological tip electrode; monophasic rectangular 100 us pulse, calibrated above threshold, 60-90 mA tested range.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: The text reports both constant-current stimulator and constant-voltage pulse wording.

soa_table.value: T1 300 ms, T2 800 ms, T3 1500 ms, T4 2200 ms, T5 2700 ms from auditory onset; T0 before sound and T6 after sound also included.
soa_table.evidence_note: Analysis retained D1-D5 and excluded T0/T6.

baseline_strategy.value: Baseline-like timings are T0 and T6, tactile events before sound onset or after sound offset; they were excluded from main RT analysis.
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: The paper does not label these as baseline trials, but their role is outside-sound comparison timing.

baseline_timing.value: T0 occurred before auditory onset and T6 after auditory offset; exact offsets within the 1000 ms pre/post silence windows are not reported.
baseline_timing.evidence_note: Exact T0/T6 SOA values remain unresolved.

catch_trial_type.value: Auditory-only catch trials with no tactile stimulation.
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: Catch trials were removed before RT analysis.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: Six target trials for each tactile timing T0-T6 per task session; analyzed D1-D5 therefore have six repetitions each per session.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: Counts are per audio-tactile task session.

baseline_count.value: T0 and T6 imply 12 baseline-like target trials per task session, six before sound and six after sound.
baseline_count.evidence_note: Derived from six target stimuli for each of seven temporal delays.

catch_count.value: Twenty auditory-only catch trials per 62-trial task session; practice/calibration included 2 catch trials among 10 trials.
catch_count.evidence_note: Experimental catch count is separate from practice/calibration.

block_count.value: Two audio-tactile task sessions per participant: pre-FAM and post-FAM; no smaller task blocks reported.
block_count.evidence_note: FAM is an intervening session, not an audio-tactile block.

total_trial_count.value: Sixty-two experimental trials per task session; two sessions imply 124 experimental task trials per participant, plus 10 practice/calibration trials.
total_trial_count.evidence_note: The 124 total is derived from the reported pre/post task repetition.

critical_caveats: Exact pink-noise sample file or generation seed is not reported.
Speaker model and room/acoustic transfer characteristics are not reported.
Exact T0 and T6 offsets within the pre/post silence windows are not reported.
No explicit response timeout/window is reported.
next_manual_action: A runnable recreation can be scaffolded from this review, but exact source asset and physical-speaker transfer function would require author data or a stated approximation.
